goal: A command-line tool that converts temperatures between Celsius and Fahrenheit.

requirements.title: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit
requirements.body: Given a Celsius value, the tool prints the equivalent Fahrenheit value rounded to two decimals.
acceptance: Given 0 C when converting then the output is 32.00
Given 100 C when converting then the output is 212.00

requirements.title: Convert Fahrenheit to Celsius
requirements.body: Given a Fahrenheit value, the tool prints the equivalent Celsius value rounded to two decimals.
acceptance: Given 32 F when converting then the output is 0.00
Given 212 F when converting then the output is 100.00

requirements.title: Clear error on invalid input
requirements.body: When the argument is not a finite number, the tool prints an error message to stderr and exits with a non-zero code.
acceptance: Given the argument 'abc' when running the tool then stderr contains an error and the exit code is 2

assumptions.text: Input arrives as a single CLI argument.
